title: [LOGGED OUT] Product title opens the product page with name, price and description
reason: Product page shows expected URL, heading, price, description and green Add to cart button

steps.text: Open https://www.demoblaze.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
Is the heading "Samsung galaxy s6" shown with the price "$360 *includes tax"?
Is "Product description" shown with text that starts with "The Samsung Galaxy S6 is powered by"?
steps.saw: Product description: The Samsung Galaxy S6 is powered by 1.5GHz octa-core Samsung Exynos 7420 processor...

steps.text: Is a green "Add to cart" button shown (look only, do not click it)?
steps.saw: Green Add to cart button (background rgb(52, 168, 83)); not clicked
